findings.priorScopeDefect: Taiwan Cement 2023 parent-only/unconsolidated disclosure had been placed beside consolidated TSMC/UMC receipts. That cross-issuer comparison is invalid without an entity-scope key.
findings.repair: Primary cross-issuer D22-01 replay now requires consolidated-group scope. Parent-only evidence may be retained only as a separately tagged secondary receipt.
findings.accountingBasisDefect: An issuer/date D22 maturity exposure and its D07 accounting baseline must not silently mix Taiwan-FSC-endorsed IFRS with IFRS-as-issued/20-F accounting totals when official filings differ.
findings.knownAtDefect: Audit date or board approval date is document chronology, not automatically public first-known time.

firewalls.primaryExposure: Use contractual <1y financing cash flows after liability-class filtering.
firewalls.D07Baseline: Use carrying balance-sheet debt/leverage/liquidity on a compatible tagged accounting basis.

issuerAudits.interpretation: Contractual cash flow materially exceeds current carrying classification; both are useful but not additive.
Contractual cash flow exceeds current carrying financing; classifications and interest/cash-flow semantics differ.
The two representations are close but still not identical; numerical closeness is not authority to sum them.

falsificationImplications: Any apparent D22 alpha created by mixing parent-only and consolidated entities is invalid.
Any apparent incremental signal created by adding carrying-current debt to contractual maturity cash flow is double counting.
Any result that changes materially after enforcing one accounting basis per issuer/date fails the robustness gate.
Receipts without a verified public knownAt cannot define the equity-outcome start time.
next: Align TSMC D07 baseline to the same accounting basis as its D22 receipt.
